ground_truth_policy: Source-level relevance authored manually from the frozen synthetic corpus BEFORE any retriever ran. required_source_keys = the minimal set of Sources genuinely needed to answer; optional_support_source_keys = corroborating Sources that may legitimately appear but are not required and are never counted as false positives. Never derived from vector/GQ/GD/LLM/retriever output. Rationale references synthetic fixture facts only.
split_policy: 30 DEV / 30 HOLDOUT, disjoint, every class present in both splits (3 each). HOLDOUT is authoritative for later value conclusions and is never used in the micro-precheck (DEV-only).
